---
title: "MANTIS proposal figures"
subtitle: "Biodiversa+ Task 2.5.3 — A4 variants, with captions and alt text"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
    fig-align: center
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    papersize: a4
    geometry: margin=25mm
    fig-align: center
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
for (f in c("profiles", "spec", "render", "checks", "document")) {
  source(file.path("R", paste0(f, ".R")))
}
specs <- document_specs()
fmt <- if (output_is_pdf()) "pdf" else "html"
```

Each figure below is the A4 variant of a spec in `figures/`. The same spec also
produces a slide variant (L1 only) and a poster variant (L1, L2 and L3); all
three are rebuilt together by `targets::tar_make()`.

Captions and alt text are read from the spec at render time, not retyped here,
so they cannot drift away from the figure they describe.

```{r}
#| label: figures
#| output: asis
for (spec in specs) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", spec$message))
  cat(figure_block(spec, profile = "a4", fmt = fmt))
  cat("\n")
}
```

## What the figures are allowed to say

Every numeric token and every milestone, deliverable, objective, risk or
activity ID in the figures above appears in `data/facts.csv`, extracted from
the proposal .docx. Anything the proposal does not supply is rendered as the
literal `[TBC]` and listed in `MISSING-INPUTS.md`.

```{r}
#| label: tbc
#| output: asis
tbc <- unlist(lapply(specs, function(s) {
  lab <- all_labels(s)
  lab$text[grepl("[TBC]", lab$text, fixed = TRUE)]
}))
if (length(tbc)) {
  cat("Labels currently carrying `[TBC]`:\n\n")
  for (t in tbc) cat(sprintf("- %s\n", t))
} else {
  cat("No figure currently carries a `[TBC]`.\n")
}
```
